attack.note: Every basic attack stacks Black Arrows, and three stacks make her hit harder, up to 50 percent after the quest and heal with Life Drain. Withering Fire and Shadow Dagger are used to feed those stacks, so her damage is auto based.

poke.note: Withering Fire auto locks the nearest enemy Hero for 5 shots and cannot be dodged, and Shadow Dagger is a targeted poison that spreads on damage. Her range is long but the real exposure comes from needing stacks.

damage.note: Dagger poison and stacked autos are spread damage that a healer can match, but Overwhelming Affliction deals 1 percent of maximum Health on autos to slowed enemies and Life Drain gives her own healing. Barbed Shot adds a 400 percent bonus on the fifth shot. The measured 2560 hero damage per minute is above median, win rate 0.482 over 2181 games, the most played hero in this batch, so she is a standard pick with an average result.

good_into.why: Black Arrows rises to 50 percent more damage at 3 stacks, Cold Embrace removes 25 Armor from the dagger target and Overwhelming Affliction deals percent maximum Health to slowed Heroes, which tanks cannot absorb.
Haunting Arrows stuns structures, Withering Fire targets towers, and Black Arrows quest stacks come from structures, so she pushes without minions.
Shadow Dagger spreads poison to nearby enemies including summons and Unstable Poison explodes minions, so she clears them quickly.
Single healers cannot keep up with Dagger spread plus fully stacked autos, and Life Drain heals her in return.
Windrunner and Will of the Forsaken give her escapes, and Wailing Arrow silences the enemies who would hold crowd control, so she has answers in her kit.

bad_into.why: Haunting Wave is her only escape and has an 11 second cooldown and 75 Mana, so a diver that kills her in one rotation wins.
Assassins with gap closers reach her through the teleport, and her Health is low.
She needs 3 stacks on one target, so mobile heroes that break line of sight reset stacks, and Shadow Dagger must hit its original target.
Her damage is spread across stacks and Dagger poison, which AoE healers erase, until the Black Arrows quest finishes.
She has no reliable burst and must stand and attack to stack, so heavy poke on her costs her the stacks and Mana.

wants_from_team: A frontline that keeps enemies at 3 stacks
Time to complete the Black Arrows quest, which makes her a mid to late game hero
Peel against divers, because Haunting Wave is her only escape
Map objectives where her stacks can be maintained on structures
gives_team: Strong wave clear and camp clear
Silence from Wailing Arrow and forced movement from Mind Control
Damage scaling against tanks and structures
weaknesses: Needs many basic attacks, so she is stationary
Win rate 0.482 shows no standout strength
evidence: Overwhelming Affliction and Life Drain talents
MEASURED block: hero damage 2560 per minute, 4.7 camps per game, 16.3 seconds of enemy stun root silence per game, 0.482 win rate over 2181 games

lens_notes.damage_timing: Power is gated by the Black Arrows quest (250 hits, then 400 for healing). Weak early, very high late.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Mind Control silences, slows and pulls a target in, then Shadow Dagger and autos finish. Measured 16.3 seconds of enemy stun, root or silence per game, the highest here.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Value for the heroic only. Wailing Arrow is a 2.5 second silence in an area. Mind Control is the single target version.
lens_notes.cc_delivery: Wailing Arrow is area and reactivated. Mind Control is a slow skillshot, so ranged picks vary by heroic.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Will of the Forsaken at level 16 is the only Unstoppable, and it is a talent choice against Evasive Fire or Life Drain.
lens_notes.escape: Haunting Wave teleport on an 11 second cooldown is her only baseline escape. Windrunner and Bolt of the Storm add more late.
lens_notes.lane_role: Unstable Poison and Shadow Dagger clear waves very fast. Haunting Arrows lets her push structures without minions.
lens_notes.split_potential: Haunting Arrows and Possession make a lane push without minions, and the quest wants structure hits.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Recommended build takes Mind Control as a pick. Wailing Arrow is the teamfight silence alternative.
lens_notes.power_curve: Could also be called late_scaler. Stack_dependent was chosen because an early completed quest changes the whole game.

lens_gaps: no value on damage_timing or power_curve for a quest gated bonus that has two tiers (250 and 400 stacks)
no value on utility_tool or wave_clear_style for taking control of enemy minions (Possession)
